data: Amazon's fiscal 2025 net sales (the year ended December 31, 2025) were about $716.9 billion, up roughly 12% from $638.0 billion in 2024. Apple's fiscal 2025 revenue (the year ended September 2025) was about $416.2 billion, up roughly 6% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Amazon was therefore about 1.7 times larger than Apple, or roughly $300.7 billion more in revenue. The two fiscal years end three months apart, and I'm giving these figures from memory rather than from a filing I just pulled, so check them against the 10-Ks before relying on them.
